clips.title: The story
paras: During the Lunar Festival, pilgrims seek Riversong the Elder beneath a shrine in Astranaar. The night elf spirit offers wisdom and points them toward other honored ancestors across Kalimdor.

In Astranaar, Riversong the Elder waits beneath an open night elf shrine. A shaft of light falls through the Ashenvale canopy onto her spirit. During the Lunar Festival, pilgrims gather there to honor those who came before.
Riversong the Elder recalls how night elves read truth and mystery in the stars. She urges patience and contemplation, then guides pilgrims toward other spirits, including Elder Starweave.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, friend. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?
